page.layout: One page of running text in a single column. Running head centred above the text, with the page number at the top right. No margin notes. Catchword at the right below the last line, with the gathering signature at the left of the same line.

main_text.p: Filium Dei, Messiam & Salvatorem populi sui: In ipsa nativitate pastoribus idem denunciat, natum ipsis esse salvatorem, Christū Dominū, hoc est, Messiam, Iehovam. Denique omnes angelorum exercitus una voce nascenti testimonium perhibent suavissime concinentes: Gloria Deo in ex-celsis, in terra pax, & hominibus beneplacitum. Huc accedunt miracula, conceptus ex Spiritu Sancto miraculosus, partus ex virgine insuetus, Spiritus propheticus in Zacharia; Portenta etiam externa, Romæ Ianiculum clausum: fons olei largissi-mus totum diem fluxit: Augustus se Dominum vocari vetuit: 30000[?] servorum manumisit: Augustus quaerens ex Pythia, quisnam post se esset regnaturus: audivit responsum:

p.i: Me puer Hebræus superum Rex, linquere tecta Hac iubet, & Ditis caecas remeare sub umbras: Ergo silens aris tu nunc abscedito nostris:

main_text.p: Aram itaq; transtulit in capitolium, cum hac inscriptione:
Ara hæc est primogeniti Dei. Orosius: Suidas.
Quæ omnia argumento sunt, hunc puerum Iesum esse Messiam primis parentibus in paradi-so promissum.

Quare agite opponamus hæc Iudæorum scan-dalo[?], sarcasmis & subsannationibus, quibus certam, manifestam & totius scripturæ divino con-fensu, testimoniis, miraculis confirmatissimam doctrinam de exhibito Messia calumniari magis quam refellere conantur. page.notes: Printed page 435, running head "LIBER IV.". The signature "Ee ij" and catchword "tria" are at the foot. "30000" is uncertain: the print may read "30ooo", so I marked it [?]. "scan-dalo" is uncertain (the print is blurred), so it is marked [?]. The "Ara" before "hæc" has a small mark in front of it that I could not read, so I left it out. The first line continues from the previous page, hence cont="true".
